nodes.text: hMPV is similar to RSV & causes mild cold & flu like sxs in the healthy adult & pediatric population. The tx is rest, fluids, & Tylenol or Motrin. It resolves in 2 weeks. If it progresses to bronchitis or pneumonia,  drugs are available thru a health care provider (HCP). https://t.co/agPJ4SdvyO
